name: lifeos
description: Free, open-source personal dashboard for self-hosted home servers, computers, and wall tablets.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir mobile build:ios
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm contract:check && pnpm changelog:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.lint: composer --working-dir=backend analyse && pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir mobile typecheck && node scripts/check-module-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: composer --working-dir=backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test && pnpm --dir mobile test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --dir frontend test:e2e
